name: Furries & Scalies: Friendswood
source:
You run the Friendswood Water Park district of Vienna Gardens. Your leader/boss, Duke Vincent, has left on business, leaving its fate in your hands.... and also the hands of Scotty from Marketing. Nobody likes Scotty Angelo, who has been trying to take over/take out the Water Park for years. You have exactly one and a half months to stop Scotty from being evil or whatever, and to prove that Friendswood shouldn't be retired from Vienna Gardens. They'll probably replace it with some sort of weird movie tie-in that really doesn't make any sense within the Friendswood area theme.
Over the course of the game, make sure your fellow workers gain the right skills needed in order to work together and deal with whatever issues the park throws at them. Go out for coffee, learn their interests, and maybe make lasting friendships.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1106950/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你负责管理维也纳花园里的友谊森林水上乐园区。你的领导兼老板文森特公爵出差去了，把乐园的命运交到了你手上……还有市场部的斯科蒂手上。没人喜欢斯科蒂·安杰洛，这些年来，他一直想把水上乐园据为己有，或者干脆毁掉它。你有整整一个半月的时间阻止斯科蒂作恶，或者做些类似的事，并证明友谊森林不该从维也纳花园中消失。他们大概会用某种莫名其妙的电影联动项目取而代之，跟友谊森林园区的主题完全搭不上边。

游戏过程中，你要确保同事们掌握所需的技能，才能齐心协力，处理乐园里冒出的各种问题。一起出去喝杯咖啡，了解他们的兴趣，或许还能结下一段长久的友谊。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1106950/]Steam[/url]]
